method: Each indicator answer scores 0 (most restrictive or punitive) to 100 (freest or best protected), or is shown as a fact (score null). An axis is the mean of its scored indicators known for that country. Unknown answers are left blank.

axes.name: Marriage
axes.question: Who may marry whom, and from what age?

axes.name: Private life
axes.question: Does the state police sex and morality between adults?

axes.name: Sexual violence
axes.question: How fully does the law protect against rape and harassment?

axes.name: LGBTQ+
axes.question: Are same-sex relationships and trans people legal, equal and protected?

axes.name: Women
axes.question: Equal standing in law, freedom of movement and reproductive choice

axes.name: Religion
axes.question: Can people of every faith, or none, practise freely?

axes.name: Pluralism
axes.question: Can parties compete and power change hands?

axes.name: Speech
axes.question: Can people criticise rulers and reach the open internet?

axes.name: Punishment

indicators.name: Minimum marriage age
indicators.question: Is 18 the minimum age for marriage, with no exceptions?
indicators.basis: National marriage and child-protection law; Girls Not Brides country pages.

values.label: Girls may marry below 18 as standard, or no floor

us.note: Varies by state; a growing number of states ban all marriage under 18.

in.note: 21 for men and 18 for women; child marriages are voidable rather than void.

gb.note: England and Wales banned under-18 marriage in 2023; in Scotland the age is 16.

sa.answer: Girls may marry below 18 as standard, or no floor
sa.note: No codified minimum; court approval is required under 18.

ng.answer: Girls may marry below 18 as standard, or no floor
ng.note: The Child Rights Act sets 18, but several northern states have not adopted it.

ir.answer: Girls may marry below 18 as standard, or no floor
ir.note: 13 for girls, lower with a father’s and a court’s approval.

pk.answer: Girls may marry below 18 as standard, or no floor
pk.note: 16 for girls in most provinces; 18 in Sindh and Islamabad.

co.note: Law 2447 of 2025 banned all marriage under 18.

kp.answer: Girls may marry below 18 as standard, or no floor

ve.note: Age 16 with parental consent since a 2014 amendment.

bd.answer: Girls may marry below 18 as standard, or no floor
bd.note: A 2017 “special circumstances” clause allows marriage below the minimum with no floor.

indicators.name: Polygamy
indicators.question: May a man take more than one wife?

in.note: Allowed for Muslims under personal law; banned for others, and in Uttarakhand under its 2024 civil code.

id.note: Requires court permission and the first wife’s consent.

ng.note: Allowed under customary and Islamic law.

il.note: Banned since 1977, though practised among some Bedouin.

sg.note: Muslims only, with Registry of Muslim Marriages permission.

ph.note: Muslims only, under the Code of Muslim Personal Laws.

indicators.name: Marriage across religions
indicators.question: Can two people of different religions marry in the country?
indicators.basis: Personal-status law; whether civil marriage exists.

in.note: Allowed under the Special Marriage Act, but several states’ anti-conversion laws target interfaith marriages.

id.note: Marriages must follow one religion, so one partner usually converts.

eg.note: A Muslim woman may not marry a non-Muslim man.

il.note: There is no civil marriage; interfaith couples marry abroad and are registered.

indicators.name: Civil marriage
indicators.question: Can a couple marry without a religious ceremony or authority?

il.note: Marriage is controlled by the religious courts of each community.

indicators.name: Male guardian for a bride
indicators.question: Does an adult woman need a male guardian’s consent to marry?
indicators.basis: Personal-status law; Hanafi law lets an adult woman marry without a guardian.

id.note: A wali is required for Muslim marriages.

ir.note: A father’s consent is required for a first marriage.

pk.note: The courts ruled in 2003 that an adult woman may marry without a guardian.

indicators.name: Equal marriage age
indicators.question: Is the minimum marriage age the same for women and men?

indicators.name: Divorce
indicators.question: Can both spouses divorce on equal terms?

il.note: In rabbinical courts a Jewish wife needs her husband to grant a get.

ph.note: Only Muslims can divorce; others can seek an annulment. Divorce bills have stalled in the Senate.

indicators.name: Daughters’ inheritance
indicators.question: Do daughters inherit equally with sons?

values.label: No, usually half a son’s share

in.note: Hindu daughters gained equal rights in 2005; Muslim personal law applies to Muslims.

eg.answer: No, usually half a son’s share

ir.answer: No, usually half a son’s share

pk.answer: No, usually half a son’s share
